name: SKF India Limited
summary: SKF India Limited engages in the manufacturing, trading, and servicing bearings, seals, and motion technologies in India and internationally. The company offers Bearings, such as rolling bearings, mounted bearings and housings, precision bearings, slewing bearings, plain bearings, magnetic bearings and systems, and thin section bearings. It also provides industrial seals including power transmission, hydraulic, fluid handling, and machined seals.
